name: Mythos Gates First Art Approval Manifest
scope: Approves prompt packages for the first deity art batch plus Mesha Gate-Scribe and The First Reopening Gate; this does not claim final image assets have been generated or imported.
canonRule: Approval may refine composition and quality gates only; it may not invent lore, alter faction identity, or mark generated images as imported.

approvalBatches.name: Aten Ra Deity Artwork Approval Batch
approvalBatches.approvalNotes: Updated to the four-god playable roster; preserves approved style while removing retired deity prompts.

approvalBatches.name: Mesha Gate-Scribe and First Reopening Gate Approval Batch
approvalBatches.approvalNotes: Mesha and the first Gate battlefield are approved together because onboarding needs a readable guide figure and matching environment anchor before final art import.

qualityGates: Mobile-readable silhouette at card and battlefield preview scale.
Every faction asset must visibly follow data/faction-visual-bible.json for silhouette, armor construction, material hierarchy, symbols, textures, and faction-specific avoid rules.
deities must read as living extradimensional mythic beings, not robots, mechs, androids, or humans in powered armor.
deities must keep readable living anatomy and character silhouette; reject blocky buildings, tower bodies, fortress torsos, stacked geometric shapes, or architecture piles masquerading as Deities.
No sci-fi firearms, futuristic craft, modern corporate UI, generic superhero styling, watermarks, or readable generated text.
Faction identity must remain unmistakable: material language, realm symbols, culture, and role silhouette must agree with canon.
Generated image may not be marked imported until a real asset file exists in the artwork pipeline.
Mesha remains non-playable campaign support; art may not imply a playable Hero class.
The First Reopening Gate must read as physical broken Gatefield terrain, not a neon board-game tile set.
rejectionTriggers: Faction drift: asset lacks the faction visual bible material/symbol/silhouette language or uses an avoid-listed trope.
Robot, mecha, android, cyborg, transformer, or powered-suit read.
Blocky building, tower, fortress, cube-stack, abstract geometry pile, or literal architecture-body read.
Sci-fi armor, firearms, vehicle parts, visible pistons, hydraulic joints, or spaceship aesthetic.
Loss of mobile readability in 360px vertical crop.
Visual contradiction of prompt negativePrompt constraints.

handoff.nextAction: Generate or receive real approved image assets, then import them through art/imported and art/approved without fabricating filenames.
handoff.blockedReason: External generated image asset still required.
